[NGST.4.1] Schemas and rules reach the engine in one compiled artefact
([NFCT.1.1]): both are written in `.ds` and compiled to a `.dsc` by
`dsc compile` ([RCLI.1.1]). An artefact whose program declares schemas and no
rules lets an integrator assert and observe facts; rules fire only where the
program declares them. The artefact
carries the Rete network with no flag. A program whose `use` names a dialect
defined in a file needs that file passed with `-d` ([NDLC.4.3]).
